parameters.responseData: Carta guardada en el vault de Obsidian. Puedes cerrar esta pestana.

parameters.jsCode:
const id = Number($('Webhook guardar-carta').item.json.query.id) || 0;
return [{ json: { id: id, selectSql: `SELECT g.carta_md, g.asunto, o.company, o.title, o.vault_path FROM empleo.generated g JOIN empleo.job_offers o ON o.id = g.offer_id WHERE o.id = ${id};` } }];
